tas.speedHint: Playback speed, relative to the record's frame rate. Change it any time during playback; it takes effect on the next frame. RockoonIO paces the game by waiting at the end of each frame, so game logic and the record's frame times are untouched

tas.helpUnified: One rule: with a selection the action applies to the selection (arrows move it, Delete clears it, the run-length box resizes it, copy / cut / paste), otherwise it applies to the current frame. Mouse mode 1 select / 2 draw / 3 fill / 4 record; Alt+drag, Space / middle-drag, wheel zoom and W / S / A / D work in every mode.

helpRows.modes: Mouse mode: 1 select (default) / 2 draw / 3 fill / 4 record (also on the toolbar)
helpRows.pickRun: Select mode: click a run to select that whole run at once
helpRows.boxSelect: Select mode: drag inside one row to box-select part of that run (no cross-row, snapped to the pressed frames)
helpRows.moveRun: Select mode: arrow keys move the selected run directly (left/right = frames, up/down = tracks); the run-length box resizes it or creates a key
helpRows.paint: Draw mode: hold left to paint
helpRows.erase: Draw mode: hold right to erase
helpRows.fill: Fill mode: drag a rectangle — left sets every cell, right clears every cell (committed on release, one undo step)
helpRows.select: Record mode: drag out a time range (spans all tracks) — mapped keys overwrite the whole selection in one go
helpRows.row: In draw/fill mode: only the row you started on is modified
helpRows.move: Grab a contiguous block and drag it (can change track)
helpRows.zoom: Zoom in / out (hold for continuous, anchored on the pointer)
helpRows.view: Hold and drag = temporarily pan the view
helpRows.tab: Next / previous frame; with a selection, shift the whole range by one frame
helpRows.jumpRun: Jump to the previous / next run edge (Shift = extend the selection too)
helpRows.home: Jump to the first / last frame
helpRows.clear: Clear the selection; with no selection, clear the keys on the current frame
helpRows.esc: Cancel the selection and the current drag (a recording key in record mode)
helpRows.reorder: Drag up/down to reorder the tracks
helpRows.lock: Click the lock icon on a track header to lock / unlock that track

tas.helpRecord: Record mode: drag out a selection, then ↑ ← → ↓ Shift Space Q Enter Esc become recording keys — one press overwrites that range (or the current frame when nothing is selected) with the keys you pressed; Tab / Shift+Tab move the cursor, or shift a whole selection by one frame. Other modes do not record.
tas.helpSelect: Select mode: click to select a whole run (clicking an empty cell = a zero-length selection); drag inside one row to box-select part of a run; arrow keys then move the selected part (overwriting whatever was at the target), and the run-length box resizes it — 0 deletes the run, and raising it above 0 on an empty cell creates a new key there.
tas.helpRunLength: Run-length box: only usable in select mode with a single-track selection. Edits apply live (each edit is one undo step).
tas.helpCover: Overwrite semantics (record mode): the first key on a frame clears the other keys of that frame (locked tracks excepted), then sets the pressed key; further presses on the same frame accumulate. Leaving the frame and coming back starts a fresh round.
tas.helpLock: Track lock: a locked track is fully read-only — drawing, erasing, recording, Alt-dragging, deleting a selection and pasting all skip it. Locks are remembered.
tas.helpPlayback: Playback (Playback section on the right): Play starts watching at the editor's current frame — earlier frames still run their physics but aren't rendered or paced, so they fast-forward; From start begins at frame 0. The speed slider can be changed any time during playback (applies on the next frame; the rightmost stop is unlimited). The game is view-only by default: clicks pass through to the editor and it can't capture the mouse; turn on Control the game when you need to send it keys (BallanceTAS F4–F8, stop key). After you stop, the game exits or you close the editor, the BallanceTAS settings changed by one-click play are restored automatically.
tas.helpBackup: Auto backup: before overwriting an existing .tas, the original is copied to <file>.tas.bak next to it (an older .bak is replaced). A failed backup never blocks saving.
tas.helpModes: Mouse modes (Edit section on the right, or 1/2/3/4): Select = click a run of keys to select all of it, drag within a row to select part of it, arrow keys move the selection, Key duration changes its length (0 = delete, > 0 on an empty cell = create); Draw = left click draws, right click erases; Fill = drag a rectangle, left button sets every cell in it, right button clears them; Record = drag a time range, then press keys to write them. In every mode Alt+drag moves a block, Space/middle-drag pans, the wheel zooms and W/S/A/D still work.
tas.helpRow: Single row: in draw/fill mode, hold Shift while dragging and only the row you started on is modified — moving the pointer onto other tracks does not write them, while frames still advance as usual.
tas.bandsHint: Show or hide the alternating background of each major tick interval (independent of the V-lines)
tas.mode: Mouse mode (1 select / 2 draw / 3 fill / 4 record)
tas.modeSelectHint: Select: click a run to select the whole run; drag inside one row to box-select part of it; arrow keys move the selected part (left/right = frames, up/down = tracks); use the run-length box to resize it or create a key.
tas.modeDrawHint: Draw: hold left button to paint frame by frame, right button to erase; hold Shift to affect only the row you started on.
tas.modeFillHint: Fill: drag a rectangle, release left to set the whole block, right to clear it (one undo step).
tas.runLengthHint: After selecting a run you can edit its frame count: 0 deletes it; on an empty cell a value above 0 creates a key there.
